title: The exceptional inverse image of Weil complexes is the Verdier conjugate of the pullback
statement: Let $k_0$ be a finite field, $\ell$ a prime different from the characteristic of $k_0$, and $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ (Lean `PadicAlgCl ℓ`). Weil complexes on a $k_0$-scheme $X$ are the objects of the category $\mathrm{WC}(X)$ of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] (Lean `WeilComplex k₀ ℓ X`). Let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a separated, quasi-compact morphism locally of finite type of $k_0$-schemes, where $X$ and $Y$ are separated $k_0$-schemes of finite type (structure morphisms separated, quasi-compact, locally of finite type). Assume that $Ra_{X,0!}$, $Ra_{Y,0!}$ and $Rf_{0!}$ have right adjoints $Ra_X^!$, $Ra_Y^!$, $Rf^!$ ([def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]), and let $D_X$, $D_Y$ be the Verdier duals $R\mathcal Hom(-,\omega_X)$, $R\mathcal Hom(-,\omega_Y)$ of [lem-sf-weil-verdier-dual-preserves-weil-complexes], with $\omega_X=Ra_X^!\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, $\omega_Y=Ra_Y^!\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Then for every Weil complex $L$ on $Y$ there is an isomorphism $Rf^!L\cong D_X\,f^*\,D_YL$ of Weil complexes on $X$, $f^*$ the pullback of Weil complexes ([def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]).

The private helper exists_dualizing_hom_equiv_reversed proves this bijection and its naturality in M directly, using right-tensor currying without a symmetry swap.

proof.text: Apply the assumed Rf! ⊣ upperShriek adjunction to obtain Hom(M,upperShriek L). Its left naturality finishes the naturality of the composite equivalence. The proved private Yoneda helper isoOfNaturalHomEquiv yields D_X(f*D_Y L) ≅ upperShriek L; take its inverse to obtain the stated isomorphism. No native-to-fixed-pair comparison or ordinary direct-image exchange is used.
